SAMRAT UTSAV IS WHERE SATI’S BUILDERS, PERFORMERS, THINKERS, GAMERS, ARTISTS, AND INNOVATORS COME TOGETHER TO CREATE MOMENTS THAT GO BEYOND THE CLASSROOM.

From ambitious technical challenges and startup ideas to music, dance, sport, and unforgettable campus nights, Samrat Utsav brings the full energy of SATI Vidisha into one shared celebration. Join students from across disciplines and colleges for an experience built on creativity, competition, collaboration, and community.

FAQ

Who can participate?

Students from SATI and other colleges. Eligibility rules will be announced by the organizing committee.

Is there a registration fee?

Entry is free for SATI students. Students from other colleges pay ₹100 per event at the registration desk. This site does not collect payments online.

When are the official dates?

18–19 FEB 2027 at the SATI Campus, Vidisha. Details are subject to updates from the organizing committee.

What should I bring?

Your college ID card and the Registration No. you receive after submitting the form.

How do I contact the organizers?

Email samratutsav@sati.ac.in or call +91 98765 43210 (Student Coordinator) or +91 91234 56789 (Faculty Coordinator).
